title: Deep learning AS-OCT segmentation profiles corneal thickness across keratoconus stages
summary: A dataset of 1,430 AS-OCT images from 715 eyes (118 normal, 134 mild, 239 moderate, 153 severe and 71 scarring keratoconus) was analyzed. A deep learning corneal segmentation algorithm isolated epithelial and corneal tissue, and thickness was measured automatically in the central 6 mm, with a measurement error below 4 μm relative to clinical experts. ANOVA and linear regression across 20 zones described how thickness changes with keratoconus progression. The study is single-center and descriptive.
ai_technology: Deep learning corneal segmentation of anterior segment OCT images

evidence.tested: Segmentation agreement with clinical experts (error under 4 μm).
evidence.unknown: Whether thickness profiles help diagnosis or staging beyond known patterns; full text not reviewed.
